page.title: Read a snapshot without restoring it
page.description: tinyactors actors and tinyactors inspect read the snapshots and hibernation blobs a host writes: each actor's chart, state, queued events and delayed sends, with no host running.

hero.headline: Find where each order is
hero.lede: A snapshot file holds the actors of a host and their pending timeouts. tinyactors actors reads from it which state each order is in, without starting a host.

section.heading: 1. Take a snapshot of the host
section.p: Your application writes a snapshot through the library, and tinyactors run writes one with run.snapshot. This session spawns 20 orders, pays some, adds the next version, hibernates order 17, then snapshots.
section.code: tinyactors run --config shop.json --system shop system.xml < shop.jsonl

section.heading: 2. Ask the file about one order
section.p: Order 6 is in paying, waiting for its charge. Its payment.timeout fires 20 seconds after the snapshot's time.
Without --session, actors lists every actor, and --chart order keeps one chart's.

section.heading: 3. Check a stored blob before waking it
section.p: Order 17 was hibernated: its state is in a blob in your store, which wakes only in its own host. inspect reads the blob and checks that this snapshot's host can wake it.

section.heading: 4. Inspect the snapshot's segments and states

item.text: The snapshot's time and its segments, one per image the host added, with how many actors each holds.
The states of the chart a segment runs, with --segment for an older version.

claim.statement: Each release reads its own formats
claim.p: Snapshots and blobs are raw memory of one build of the library, each format with a version. The command reads its own library's formats, and names any other.
